description: Full canvas with a top strip of three small-multiple histograms and a lower area of multi-row stacked bars.

components.description: Top strip containing three visually separated histogram panels.
Template for a single small histogram panel; laid out as a 1D_LIST across the top strip. The coordinate bounds cover all panel instances.
Lower area: multiple horizontal rows of stacked rectangles; each row consists of several segments arranged left-to-right with consistent row height and gaps between rows.

primary.explanation: Three histogram panels arranged horizontally across the strip.
A single histogram panel with several vertical bins arranged along x.
Eight horizontal rows of stacked bars in the lower area.

secondary.explanation: Each row subdivides into four left-to-right stacked segments (e.g., red, blue, green, orange).
